qc.label_under_test: the words ' hung' (hung over, hung on a wall, hung up on) and ' hit' in the passive sense of being struck by misfortune ('were hit hardest'), as against an active physical hit or 'hungry'

neighbours.label: the token ' hung' in any sense (strongest in hung over, hung up on, hung jury), and 'hit' / 'struck' / 'hammered' used passively for being struck by misfortune ('were hit hardest by'); not active hitting, not the whole word 'hungry'
fire: He woke up badly hung over after the wedding reception.
The trial ended with a hung jury after three days of deliberation.
She's still hung up on her ex from college.
He hung the painting above the fireplace.
The coastal towns were hit hardest by the hurricane.
Small farms were struck by a devastating drought last summer.
Retailers were hammered by the sudden drop in consumer spending.
The phone call ended abruptly when he hung up on me.
quiet: He woke up feeling awful after the wedding reception.
The trial ended with the jury unable to agree after three days.
She still thinks about her ex from college.
He placed the painting above the fireplace.
The coastal towns suffered most from the hurricane.
Small farms endured a devastating drought last summer.
Retailers struggled with the sudden drop in consumer spending.
The kids were hungry after the long hike.

predictions: Expect hung-over/jury/hit-hardest to fire; the literal painting 'hung' and 'struck by drought' are the risks (probed 0.44 and 0.37-ish earlier), so maybe 6-7/8 fire, 0-1 near misses.
